about: R22 (docs/multisig-machines.md §36): a plain verdict stands on two independent sources. `sim`: a corroborated envelope (`corroborate` module) read by `sim_outcome::verdict_of_envelope` for user 0x88cCA0EeDbF2C4426110bbFc998F048689266894; `owner`: an unlisted Safe's isOwner read (`parent_safe_guard::classify_corroborated`); `provider`: who runs an RPC URL (`corroborate::provider_of`). Replayed by the core and every shell. `authority` (§39, R22 follow-up r22-2): an exact authority read (owners, threshold, modules, guard, nonce) read by `corroborate::authority_read` — `own` for the member's own multisig flow, `site` for a guard against a site (§31's isOwner): one provider on a network whose pool holds no other (`soleProvider`) goes on in the own flow as "… anyway" (`one_node`) and stays refused for a site; two that agree are believed; two that disagree are refused in both. `fee_rose` (§39, r22-3 / A1): a site's request — the fee the sheet showed when the confirm began (`shown`, `SignApproveOpts.quoted_fee`) against the quote at the approve (`now`, `current_fee`), read by `sign_request::fee_rose`: `rose` true signs nothing (`SignErrorKind::FeeRose`; a swipe then answers the site 4001); false signs `shown`.
